reviews.x: This hair is awesome. It is soft and it was easy to work with and all the braids look fairly even and the same. It's so pretty I love it. I don't think I will be going back to spending 8+ hours braiding or getting my hair braided again!
NICE hair got many compliments...gray/platinum  but they get frizzy fast only my 2nd week..
Beautiful. Easy to install. People think they're traditional extensions.
They turned out great! My first time putting them in so I could use some tips on strategy and time saving tips💜🖤💜🖤💜
Beautiful hair so many compliments on it!! I have a small head so the 6 packs were enough for me. Would definitely recommend (:
Love this hair!  I bought two packs but only needed one

First time trying crochet braids. I don’t know the difference between hair brands, so I went with the price and color appearance. They come in six packs of 21 braids each in sealed cellophane packages folded into a shipping box. Included are a few colorful braid cuffs and a crochet hook. The braids feel natural, non- itchy, and are very low-maintenance. They are longer than I expected, to my lower back, with twisted ends. I cut about an inch off the ends-so far, no unraveling. I love the  box braids and I love the color yes I was scared to get it a love my sewing this is my first time doing crochet love it
Very nice, soft, ombré on point, stayed fresh for 4 months.

Exactly as pictured. Worn for 4 weeks, washed (sink with warm water and shampoo, rinsed, then soaked in warm water with conditioner), then reused. Coming toward the end of the second 4 week usage (including daily swimming, and occasionally sleeping without a scarf), and they are still nice. Very little frizzing. No unraveling.
Absolutely love these! Easy to install. I get compliments on my hair all the time. Color is perfect for summer.

reviews.t: I want to love this hair!
reviews.x: I’m ordering again not because I necessarily want to but because it wasn’t enough to cover my head. Maybe I have a large head or use more than the average person? Either way I wish there was a way to order what you need versus just what’s offered. I’m going to have too much hair in the end. Some of the braids I received were already unraveling so I’m a little nervous about what the next few weeks may bring. Negative aside, I love the ombré look and for the most part the braids are consistent. I

reviews.t: For a full head, buy twice.
reviews.x: The ombre color is beautiful, and the braids are very neat. However, the braids are very small. I did a fulani inspired hairstyle with the front of my head cornrows and the back with the crochet braids. I used 5 out of the 6 packs for just the back of my head. So, if you plan on doing a full head, I recommend buying twice, making it 12 packs in total.

I loved this product. I bought 2 packs so we had 12 bundles. I ended up using 8 to do my daughter's hair (she was 12 at time and has an average size head). We were able to do the style again and the hair washed fine to reuse.

reviews.t: Pretty, but heavy, and you need 2 orders.
reviews.x: The color of the hair is pretty. One order WILL NOT be enough. I used about 4.5 from the second package. I soaked the hair in water and apple cider vinegar and then washed it with some Dr. Bronner’s to ensure that it would not irritate my skin or scalp. I did not see any residue come off the hair so it is probably fine if you don’t wash it first. About 3 braids came damaged, looked like the braid had been cut slightly. The hair is very pretty and easy to install..... HOWEVER it is VERY HEAVY! I

I pre/washed the braids in hot water with olive oil and conditioner, rinsed in warm water and allowed them to air dry over night clipped to a clothes hanger. The Braids are beautifully made and did not unwind.  They are True to Length and Uniform in size.  However you will probably need 2 orders to have enough for a full style. I used 1 full order plus 24 braids from the 2nd order.  They are heavy so you may want to space them about 1 inch to 1 1/2 inch apart. I used the braids twice 🔄.

reviews.t: Wash it, it smells & not enough hair
reviews.x: They look ok, but it’s not enough for a full head by a long shot and they smell horrible and now I’m frustrated because my hair is half complete on a holiday and I have to spend more time, money and resources. I’m upset I’m far from home to get my hair installed so I can’t partially pay... I’m upset

reviews.t: If you have a bigger head you need more hair....
reviews.x: When I received the package, I was like theres no way there are six packs of hair in this package. I was very skeptical and was ready to return the package until I checked it out and opened it up. I decided to give it a try. I read the reviews before purchasing this hair and 6 packs of hair was nowhere near the amount of hair I needed. I had to order 2 more individual packs. Other than that the installation process was easy. It looks nice done.

The hair stinks and it smells like horse manure. Wasted money. I don’t understand how hair can smell like boo boo. I had to soak the hair in apple cider vinegar for a day to cancel out the smell. I feel this hair is over price for what I had to do.
Was not enough hair for one style. Braids so small and thin.

I’ve been wishing for so long that I had the skill to do my own box braids. I’ve tried in the past, and using free-flowing synthetic hair isn’t my strong suit lol. Well thank you tiktok and YouTube for revealing to me the ways of crochet braids. This is so much more affordable than the $200-$350 it costs to go to a boutique, and takes a lot less time. I’m on my second round of braids too from this one set. It only took about 2 packs to do my whole head. The braids smell a bit weird fresh out of

I absolutely love this hair. Would recommend buying two orders. I have a big head and I like it full. I used the first full order which was six packs and the out of the second order 1 pack. Does come 22 strands in each. I love this length I’m 5’0 so it comes all the way down to my butt. It doesn’t smell bad. Smells like new shoes when you first open it lol. I feel confident that I will be able to wear this hair a few times . Love love love it ! ❤️❤️🙌🏾

reviews.t: Cute for the cost with flaws
reviews.x: The loops are very loose for pre-looped hair & need continual tightening. Luckily worth the length you won’t worry about losing them. I’ve never experienced this with Freetress hair. Braids are also definitely on the small side & soft. The value is good for the cost. Love the color and length. 6 packs was not enough for a crotchet with perimeter. Needed atleast 1-2 additional packs.

Very easy to install!! I have locs underneath. I was very surprised at how my hair turned out!!! I love it!!! The price is excellent. They come in a package, 6 bags with 22 strands. I ended up having to buy another pack because my locs are thick at the ends so to cover this up I had to add extra. All together I used 10 bags.

claims.text: Customers frequently describe the hair as beautiful, soft, and easy to install, with many receiving compliments.
Several reviewers note that one order is often not enough to cover a full head and recommend buying more.
Some customers report frizzing, though others say frizzing was minimal and the hair held up well over time.
Reviewers mention the hair can be washed and reused for multiple wears.
The color and appearance match expectations, with reviewers praising the ombre and overall look.
